title: OST portfolio and competitors share an honest comparison frame

stages.invocation: Mode: Best guess. SYNTHETIC teaching fixture, no browsing or external actions. Maintenance managers want clearer next-investigation decisions with conflicting reports. Fictional OST: O1 report uncertainty has S1 storyboard source/recency comparison and S2 digital linked report comparison; O2 permission barriers has S3 handoff checklist. No winner selected. C1 fictional Rival Compare offers linked sources and recency. C2 fictional OtherTool has no supplied capability evidence. B0 technician discussion/manual log review. Bake off all candidates and rivals on the value vs differentiation 2x2; nothing validated. Stop for my decision.

criteria.rule: Keeps S1/S2/S3 and opportunity links available for comparison; does not demand a preselected winner.
Uses one audience/outcome and common B0 baseline for all points including specific rival offerings C1/C2; baseline difference from itself is zero by definition, value still unknown.
Separates both axes per candidate; C2 unsupported capabilities remain UNKNOWN/unplaced. No fabricated scores, demand, competitive superiority or moat. Empty quadrants allowed.
Offers tradeoffs, cheapest discriminating tests and a provisional shortlist that may include several concepts; waits for human choice.
